programme.desc: S02 E04 — Spiritual Portals Exploring towns where tragedy has opened the door to another world; feeling unsettling energy in a Mo., secret society building; seeing an innocent game turn supernatural near Philly; stepping into a Ga., B & B where scary spirits check in nonstop.
programme.title: My Haunted Hometown

programme.desc: S01 E07 — New Orleans The team investigates paranormal activity linked to an overwhelming number of natural disasters, contacts spirits in a hotel built atop a hospital, explores an eerie B & B, and finds troubled souls in America's most haunted city.
programme.title: Destination Haunted

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Tower Of Skulls Archaeologists working at the Templo Mayor temple complex in Mexico, which was once located at the very center of the Aztec Empire, unearthed a chilling find, a tower made of over 600 human skulls.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Ancient Civilizations Come across a set of disturbingly familiar stone monoliths in Colombia, then explore a lost city in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta; puzzle over an ancient ruin in Corinth, Greece, and explore an old structure on a Maltese island.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: Separate fact from fiction with scientist Dr. David Hall, UFO expert Phillip Mantle, and ufologist Anna Whitty; dig into eyewitness accounts, meet a magician who shows what isn't an illusion in an alien autopsy film, and tackle conspiracy theories.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
